exam: TNPSC Group II / IIA · 2025 General Studies and Aptitude
scope: Q101–135 of printed Q101–200 (35/100). Mirror PDF pages 1–33 correspond to printed booklet pages 43–75, CCSE2-2AT/2025 (Tamil variant). Editorial English adaptations, not bilingual verbatim. Specimen tentative ticks only; final key not verified. Q101 referred to expert committee; Q113 HTML transcription conflicts with scan; Q116 terminology, Q118 tied rank and Q124 institutional attribution flagged.

questionCandidates.text: Which epoch/period combination does the specimen offer for the emergence of modern humans?
issues: Visually reviewed mirrored CCSE2-2AT/2025 specimen scan page 1, printed page 43. Editorial adaptation, not verbatim; tentative key only; ungraded.
Expert committee referral; no tentative tick. Modern Homo sapiens emerged in the Pleistocene (Quaternary), absent from these choices.
